shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "echo 'Reviewing current app files and relevant Next docs next.' && ls -la app && rg -n \"after\\(|analytics|pageview|page view|server component\" app node_modules/next/dist/docs -S"
/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && echo '---' && sed -n '1,200p' app/page.tsx && echo '---' && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/after.md"
/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba app/page.tsx && echo '---' && nl -ba lib/analytics.ts && echo '---' && nl -ba tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && echo '---' && git diff -- app/page.tsx lib/analytics.ts tsconfig.json"
